title: Practised Hands
logline: At a stall handing out free food through a festival night, one volunteer's hands move without a wasted motion after twenty years; beside them, someone doing it for the first time can barely meet a stranger's eye.
human_question: Does kindness get easier, or does it only start to look different once you have done it enough times?

situation.what_happens: A volunteer-run stall gives food and drink away through a long night to whoever passes. Two people work side by side at the same task: one who has done it for decades and one who has never done it before. The experienced volunteer's movements are economical and unhesitating; the newcomer is awkward, slow and visibly self-conscious about handing something to a stranger. By dawn the difference has either narrowed or it has not.
situation.who_is_involved: A long-serving volunteer; a genuine first-timer; the organisers who run the stall; the strangers who come through it, who are guests rather than recipients of charity.
situation.what_is_at_stake: For the newcomer, the small humiliation of being bad at something simple. For the veteran, years of unremarked work suddenly being looked at. For the viewer, whether ease is evidence of goodness or only of practice.
situation.how_it_unfolds: A night like this has its own curve: setting up, a slow start, a rush that leaves no room for self-consciousness, a long flat stretch, and an exhausted clearing away. Its pressures are crowd size, supplies running out, and tiredness. Reality decides whether the newcomer settles, whether the two volunteers speak to each other at all, and what either of them makes of the night afterwards.

concept_merge.why_together: C023 names proficiency (pāguññatā) among the nineteen factors of every good mind and describes it in exactly these terms: someone used to giving finds giving easy and even sweet, while someone who has never done it hesitates, feels shy or afraid. C011 supplies the guard-rail: the hesitant act and the practised one are both fully wholesome, and prompted or unpractised goodness is never called unreal. Together they let a film watch skill and virtue come apart.
concept_merge.what_it_reveals: That the tradition treats kindness as closer to a skill than to a temperament — it gets lighter with use — without letting the beginner's clumsy version count for less.

concept_links.why: Proficiency makes practised good action easy and even sweet, and its absence brings hesitation and awkwardness at doing it for the first time [C023-P:L153-L157]. The digest adds the second sense the Pradeepika gives it, soundness or 'not being sick', which is not carried by this situation and should not be claimed for it.

The eight kinds include prompted and unpractised wholesome minds, and the digest is explicit that the sources never treat prompted or joyless goodness as fake, only as generally ranked below the unprompted [C011-P:L93-L109; C011-M:L28].

what_the_viewer_could_understand: The texts treat goodness as something that becomes easier with repetition, like a skill, while still counting the awkward first attempt as fully good.
what_must_be_real: Real volunteers giving a real night of their own time, and a first-timer who is actually a first-timer. No staged nerves, no recruited beginner, and no event convened so that it can be filmed.
position_hint: middle: it depends on the viewer already accepting ordinary giving as goodness, and then complicates it with the question of practice.
risks: Performative generosity staged for the camera
Treating the people served as background rather than as people
Making the newcomer's awkwardness into comedy, or into a verdict on them
drop_if: No genuine first-time volunteer can be found
The event turns out to be organised specifically for filming

connections.note: Both watch free giving to strangers become practised; IDEA-0093 holds the group's slot for that situation.
Both belong to the same set of six paired factors, this one to proficiency and that one to lightness.

selection.reason: Strong and well grounded, but the group's ten slots are filled and its leading concept would have to be added to the opening film's concept set to be carried; held for a later slot or as a second idea for that film.
